newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P gives BBB- corp rating to Mulialand.
newsitem.headline: S&P gives BBB- corp rating to Mulialand.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it had assigned BBB-minus corporate credit rating to Indonesia's PT Mulialand, adding that the rating outlook is stable.
The rating agency said in a statement that the rating reflected Mulialand's strong market position and prime asset quality in the property business.

But these strengths were offset by the company's single exposure to the Jakarta market, short lease maturity profile and lumpy cash flows as a result of Mulialand's property trading activities, it said.

S&P said Mulialand's rating outlook was stable as its focus on maintaining a majority of recurrent rental income, supplemented by one-off trading opportunities, would assist in the addition of incremental assets.

The rating agency said it expected that the retail asset would perform adequately and that the forecast office and retail developments successfully would be consummated within the articulated prudential framework.
